items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole to beat Talor Gooch at LIV Golf Korea, earning his eighth career LIV title and first of 2026.

items.headline: PGA Tour CEO On Star Matchups
items.text: The PGA Tour’s CEO emphasized the tour’s overhaul aims to get top players competing against each other more often to boost fan engagement.
